reply_text:
I replied to Pree in her DM. Keep Tuesday, Nov 10 at 10:30 free for the Petrel call. That's her weekly Petrel rollout call with Tansleigh Packaging, which she told me about herself in this DM on Oct 14.

I also pointed out that her Tansley Parcel (Quillon) call is later the same day, at 14:45, because the two names are easy to mix up.

My first reply said the Petrel call wasn't on her calendar for next week. That was wrong to say: the calendar I checked returned nothing, but it's probably mine, not hers. I sent a second message taking that back and asking her to check her own calendar.
